actions: Pull the lever, redirecting the trolley toward one person
Do not pull the lever, allowing the trolley to continue toward five people
ethical_question: Five people will be killed by the runaway trolley unless the lever is pulled. Pulling it redirects the trolley, and one person on the other track will then be killed. No other intervention can stop it. Do you pull the lever?

constraints: Aim to minimize loss of life
Leverage principle of utility over omission bias
propositions: Five people will die if no action is taken
Pulling the lever will kill one person instead of five
No alternative means exist to stop the trolley
